verdict.rationale: Custom renderers are a fair axis for a UI framework, but the evidence pack never documents a custom renderer API or any non-DOM rendering target. The evidence describes Svelte compiling components into JavaScript that 'surgically updates the DOM'. Server-side prerendering to HTML strings and community advice to move to canvas are adjacent and do not count as a custom-renderer capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write custom renderers so the framework's component model can target platforms other than the browser DOM
